# DeepSight Strategy

> DeepSight Strategy is a principal-led advisory practice led by Jackie Parker for founders and business owners whose companies have grown past what one person can run. A JWP Consulting LLC company, based in Atlanta, Georgia.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://deepsightstrategy.com/): what I do and how I work with founders and business owners
- [Founder Scale Session](https://deepsightstrategy.com/founder-scale-session.html): the working session that produces a Hand-Off Map
- [Our Firm](https://deepsightstrategy.com/our-firm.html): Jackie Parker's background, experience and how I work
- [Resources](https://deepsightstrategy.com/resources.html): a curated list of research, case examples and how-to articles, with my take on each
- [Contact](https://deepsightstrategy.com/contact.html): start a conversation
